Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Soojin (Legal/Privacy) and Vivek (Infra) who will own the evidence and technical details.

Short answers up front (summary):
- Region-pinning: customers can request "region-pinning" per account which limits primary inference and persistent storage to the specified region(s) (EU in your case). We bind model-serving endpoints and persisted artifacts (logs, fine-tuning artifacts) to the region.
- Temporary cross-region processing: we have a documented exception policy for short-lived failover/maintenance windows (rare) with maximum planned duration of 72 hours and emergency failover up to 7 days if extraordinary conditions require it; unplanned events trigger immediate notification and daily status updates until resolved.
- Transient caching: inference KV caches may exist on adjacent zones/replicas for latency reasons; these caches are encrypted in transit and at rest and are cleared per our retention policy. Any caching outside pinned regions is subject to the exception policy above.

Attachments I will circulate (SOC2 redacted, subprocessor roster, and a routing diagram) and Soojin will add DPA/license clause references. If you want a narrower SLA (e.g., max 24-hour emergency window) we can discuss contract language & pricing.

I'll send the formal packet by COB Monday and propose a short call to walk through the diagram.

Jasmine

Soojin / Jasmine — quick technical confirmation: 

- Primary inference / persistent storage: bound to customer-selected region (we deploy model replicas and persistent object stores within that region).
- KV cache & batching nodes: by default colocated in-region; however, during autoscaling or AZ evacuation we have transient affinity to neighboring region endpoints which may pull limited ephemeral cache shards. These are encrypted with customer-blind keys (platform-managed) and are purged within 6 hours after failback.
- Cross-region replication for backups: backups are tenant-scoped and can be configured to remain in-region on request (default cross-region replication used only for high-availability customers who opt in).
- Monitoring & notification: automated incident push to customer webhook + email; for pinning exceptions we will open a ticket with daily updates and an ETA.

I attached a simplified routing diagram and the latest subprocessor roster (redacted emails). Marissa — pricing note acknowledged.
